name: Tsuma Ijiri
source:
Main character has a young and cute bride Misaki. Living with her has its downsides, but these are fun days without any complaints. One day her finds her mischievous picture at the Internet image board. Is Misaki cheating? Or is it a threat? He sets out to find the true identity of the man who knows so much about Misaki.

[From [url=https://vndbreview.blogspot.com/2019/09/vn-of-month-january-2005-tenshi-no.html]vndbreview[/url]]
